claims: The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament is currently underway.
The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament runs from Tuesday, April 14, to Friday, April 17.
Games of the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament are streamed exclusively on Prime Video.
On April 14, the Charlotte Hornets defeated the Miami Heat 127–126 in overtime.
The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament determines the final two playoff seeds (7 and 8) in each conference for teams finishing 7th through 10th in the regular season.
In the 7th vs. 8th seed game, the winner earns the No. 7 playoff seed.
In the 7th vs. 8th seed game, the loser plays the winner of the 9/10 game.
In the 9th vs. 10th seed game, the loser is eliminated.
In the 9th vs. 10th seed game, the winner advances to play the loser of the 7/8 game for the No. 8 seed.
Eastern Conference teams are Hornets, Heat, Magic, and 76ers.
Hornets already advanced past the Heat.
Western Conference teams are Suns, Trail Blazers, Clippers, and Warriors.
All games are available on Amazon Prime Video.
The NBA Playoffs officially begin on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
